summary: Two-way chat and events between your Factorio multiplayer server and Discord. Joins, deaths, research and rocket launches reach your channel; Discord messages come back in game. Built into the AleForge hosting panel, or self-host it.
tags_intentionally_empty: No tag in the live portal vocabulary is honestly true of a chat bridge; it is a gameplay-domain vocabulary. 69% of the top 146 Utilities mods carry no tags, including helmod and informatron, so discovery rests on title and summary.
